Introduction to KSL

Kathmandu Shikshalaya Lalitpur, located in Lalitpur, is a well-disciplined school that focuses on quality education and the overall development of students. Its friendly learning environment helps students understand lessons through teaching, discussions, practical activities, and creative learning. Teachers guide students and encourage them to ask questions, improve their knowledge, and develop confidence. The school teaches important values such as discipline, teamwork, respect, and responsibility. Students also get opportunities to participate in educational programs, competitions, and extracurricular activities. Through its learning process, Kathmandu Shikshalaya helps students become confident, hardworking, and independent individuals who are prepared for a bright and successful future.

Important Rules

  1. Students must wear the proper school uniform.
  2. Students must be punctual and attend school regularly.
  3. Students must respect teachers, staff, and other students.
  4. Students must be discipline and obey teachers.
  5. Students must be speaking English Language in School
  6. Students must be on time
  7. Students must do their work on time
